item.title: 5 simple ways to relieve the aches and pains of sitting at a desk all day
item.description: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.
item.content:encoded: Sitting at a desk all day hurts. And it isn't good for us. Strategies to make it a little more comfortable, from eye muscle exercises to alleviate eye strain to a back pain-fighting body movement.

item.title: See how Big Tech is transforming Spain's landscape
item.description: A drought-stricken region of northeast Spain has become a focus for American companies searching for locations to place their data centers.

item.title: Oracle's debt is growing. The tech giant's investors are concerned
item.description: Oracle, the multinational tech giant has taken on a lot of loans to build up its AI capacity. But Oracle's investors are not happy with this piling debt load.

item.title: An AI chatbot files for bankruptcy. Is it a bad omen for the industry?
item.description: Character.AI, which lets users create custom chatbots for immersive roleplaying, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy following a string of legal challenges and the loss of top talent.

item.title: What if an AI bubble bursts — and that accelerates AI job losses?
item.description: Research on past recessions suggests downturns can accelerate automation. That raises the specter of a double whammy for workers.

item.title: TikTok staff raised child safety alarms. Court records show executives failed to act
item.description: The warnings surfaced in a trove of unreported court records. "I have been fighting about fixing this for months with people who didn't think the harms are severe enough," wrote one executive.

item.description: Dublin, Ireland, is a longtime hub for American tech companies. A group of workers held a summit to discuss their concerns about AI in Irish workplaces and life.

item.description: AI models are transforming hurricane forecasting. They provided some of the most accurate predictions of the track of Hurricane Isaias.

item.title: At SF Tech Week, a vibe check on how people in Silicon Valley feel about the AI boom
item.description: In Silicon Valley, the AI boom means a lot of people are excited about this new technology, but concerned about when the music might stop. NPR went to San Francisco Tech Week to take the pulse.
